subject: BlueLoom architecture deep-dive — VPC / on-prem / air-gapped scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@blueloom.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T14:02:00-05:00
Subject: BlueLoom — request: architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped)

Hi Hannah + Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week. We need a focussed technical deep-dive to validate networking and operational requirements for a private deployment (we're evaluating VPC-hosted and an on-prem air-gapped option). Key items we want to cover:

- Network boundary and egress controls (IP ranges, NATs, jump hosts)
- Storage & key management (KMS integration expectations)
- Update/upgrade path for an air-gapped install
- Runbook / on-call handoff and support flow (SLA expectations)

Can you share 60–90 minute slots next week? We are RIT / EST-based (Boston) but can be flexible. I attached our initial network diagram and a short questionnaire for scope.

Attachments: network_diagram_v1.pdf, prelim_deploy_questionnaire.xlsx

Alex Moreno
Head of Infrastructure
BlueLoom Health
alex.moreno@blueloom.com
+1 617-555-0123
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@blueloom.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BlueLoom — request: architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped)

Alex — thanks for the context and the attachments. We can do a 75 minute deep-dive to cover the items you listed. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 2026-12-15 09:00–10:15 PT
- Wed 2026-12-16 11:00–12:15 PT
- Mon 2026-12-21 08:00–09:15 PT

A couple of quick asks so we can tailor the runbook discussion:
1) Which KMS provider do you plan to use (cloud KMS, HSM, or customer-managed on-prem)?
2) Do you expect us to publish outbound IP ranges for the VPC option, or will you route through a customer-managed NAT?
3) Are there any SCAP/STIG or DISA baseline requirements we should know about?

Diego — can you bring the on-prem packaging and upgrade flow notes? Marissa, can you coordinate the calendar once Alex confirms a slot?

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Technical Solutions
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@blueloom.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueLoom — request: architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped)

Quick notes from infra:

- For VPC option we typically publish a small set of egress IP ranges; if BlueLoom wants to NAT through customer-managed gateways that's supported but will change our support model slightly (we'll need access to routing details during cutover).
- For air-gapped installs, upgrades are delivered as signed artifacts; we'll want a short maintenance window and a documented patching playbook.
- KMS: we support cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and can integrate with customer HSMs via PKCS#11. If you're using an on-prem HSM we'll need cert export details ahead of time.

Prework I suggest you share before the call: allowed CIDR ranges, proxy/firewall white-listing rules, and a sample service account with least privilege (we can use a redacted example).

I'll prepare a short slide with upgrade flow and an ops escalation diagram.

- Diego
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@blueloom.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@blueloom.com
Date: 2026-12-13T08:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: BlueLoom — request: architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped)

Thanks — appreciate the detail. Dec 15 is tight for our engineering leads. Mon 2026-12-21 works but our security team is out that week for audits. Can you do Mon 2026-12-20 11:00–12:15 ET? That would be 08:00–09:15 PT for you.

We use AWS KMS for cloud and have a planned on-prem HSM (Luna) for air-gapped. We'll upload the completed questionnaire and an updated CIDR list to the Drive link you shared by EOD Friday.

Alex
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@blueloom.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T07:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BlueLoom — request: architecture deep-dive (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped)

Confirmed for 2026-12-20 11:00–12:15 ET (08:00–09:15 PT). Calendar invite sent to the attendee list; agenda and prework are attached. For quick reference I dropped three items in the Drive folder:

- Redwood private deploy agenda (redwood_private_architecture_agenda.md)
- Ops escalation diagram (ops_escalation_v1.svg)
- Preflight checklist (prelim_deploy_questionnaire_filled.xlsx)

Please ensure the questionnaire includes the CIDR(s) and the contact for your HSM admin. We'll run through the network diagram, KMS/HSM flow, and then a short upgrade/playbook walk-through. If anyone else from your side should be on the call (netops, PKI), loop them in and I'll update the invite.

See you on the 20th — Hannah
